entities.name: Compleation
entities.description: The state of Phyrexian maturity and perfection, in which organic parts are replaced with artifice, typically killing the body and removing the soul.

entities.name: Glistening oil
entities.description: The substance that initiates phyresis in a subject.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane whose Phyrexians practice compleation and whose service the compleated fanatically desire.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: Master of the Progress Engine whose research on kami allowed planeswalkers to be compleated without losing their sparks.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker, the first to undergo Jin-Gitaxias's special compleation process.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker compleated and later restored, though he kept his purified metal enhancements.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker compleated and later restored, whose spark was damaged.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped un-compleat Ajani and Nissa and lost his spark doing so.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped with the healing ritual with her ghostform.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped remove Phyrexian metal from Nissa.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A healer who inoculated the patients and died in the ritual.

entities.name: Teferi Akosa
entities.description: A planeswalker who slowed time during the healing ritual.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A planeswalker whose spark and theory were used as a filter in the ritual.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker cured of compleation, possibly because of the voluntary removal of her spark before Linvala's Halo.

entities.name: Linvala
entities.description: An angel whose blast of Halo struck Nahiri.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who preserved a sliver of his and Vraska's minds and was un-compleated.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker un-compleated with Jace's help.

entities.name: Ranna
entities.description: Jace's mother, a skilled healer.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker protected from the glistening oil by an inoculation from Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder Dragon who furnished Tezzeret's inoculation.

entities.name: Norn
entities.description: Phyrexian whose influence compleated beings were under until her defeat.

entities.name: Desparkening
entities.description: Concurrent event that damaged Nissa's spark.

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias's research on kami lets New Phyrexia compleat a planeswalker without removing the soul; Tamiyo is the first.
events.quote: which they put into practice by compleating Tamiyo

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias subjects captive planeswalkers like Ajani Goldmane to ever more painful procedures.
events.quote: eagerly subjected captive Planeswalkers like Ajani Goldmane to ever more effective

events.summary: Karn, Kaya, Koth, Melira and Teferi Akosa perform a ritual to un-compleat Ajani and Nissa; Melira dies and Karn loses his spark.
events.quote: The process was so taxing as to kill Melira and cost Karn his spark

events.summary: Nahiri is cured of compleation by unclear means.
events.quote: Nahiri, another planeswalker, was also cured of compleation

events.summary: Jace and Vraska are un-compleated through a three-pronged process involving Jace's mental preservation, a telepathic command and Ranna's healing.
events.quote: Jace and Vraska were also un-compleated, through a three-pronged process.

relations.note: His research enabled compleation of planeswalkers.
relations.quote: through Jin-Gitaxias 's research on kami in Kamigawa

relations.note: Furnished Tezzeret an inoculation against glistening oil.
relations.quote: an inoculation furnished by Nicol Bolas
Jace's mother Ranna, a skilled healer
